topic: Mixture of Experts Only Wakes Up 3% of the Brain
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Ever wonder how giant AIs handle so much information? Turns out, they're not using their whole 'brain' all the time!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Models like Mixtral have hundreds of billions of parameters (like brain connections).
🔹 But for each word or 'token,' only a tiny fraction (2 out of 64 'expert' networks) actually activate.
🔹 This 'Mixture of Experts' (MoE) technique makes these massive AIs incredibly fast and efficient, even though 97% of their 'brain' is sleeping!
